submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the exact edit target, not a loose reference. Image2 and Image3 only show the small far-side empty fist peeking at the front of the collar. Image4 is approved painting style only. Preserve image1's entire original canvas composition and silhouette scale. Do not enlarge, reframe or recenter.
Make only two tiny related local edits on image1: (1) remove the small rear RIGHT empty hand and rear sleeve visible beneath the quiver at the waist; close that area with existing robe/torso occlusion. (2) let this same far-side RIGHT hand peek out just in front of the collar/chest, below the chin and just behind the near LEFT shoulder, as a small naturally closed empty fist with a tiny cuff, between the poses in image2 and3. Most of the RIGHT arm is hidden behind the torso and the near shoulder; do NOT draw a new large white sleeve in front. No hand at the rear remains.
CRITICAL: the visible near LEFT shoulder and its existing long white sleeve must remain exactly connected to the LEFT hand holding the long bow. Do not reassign that near shoulder to the empty fist. Do not redraw or bend the near LEFT shoulder/sleeve. The tiny RIGHT fist is behind that intact near LEFT shoulder; its upper arm is occluded, not growing from the left sleeve.
Freeze every other pixel region as closely as possible: exact same head/hair, collar, quiver, long bow and bow grip, left arm, robe/skirt, white shorts, both thighs/knees/ankles/boots, support and raised foot positions, heel/toe directions, ornaments, materials, scale, camera and canvas margins of image1. Preserve its bent-knee support stance, no leg edit at all. Do not copy image2/3 legs. One independent transparent RGBA sprite, no background/shadow/text/new accessories. Keep original bright detailed rounded chibi painting.
